{{Top|leg}}
The '''Bacta Yards''' was a section of the [[Tallaani Shipyards]] leased by the government of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]]. The Yards were used to store [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] in large storage tanks and silos, and to service Thyferra's fleet of bacta transports. The Bacta Yards were also used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] to inspect bacta heading to the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="LE">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref>
